rationale: Specialist payments trade press producing recurring Kosovo-relevant vendor/licence items; durable standalone monitoring target.
Authoritative recurring BQK annual card/ATM/POS estate series at a stable re-dated URL; baseline dataset for the acceptance and self-service estate.
BQK publications hub carrying the monthly statistical bulletin; highest-frequency official signal of estate change.
RaiPay wallet sub-page of the Raiffeisen Kosovo site; covered by monitoring the bank domain, adds nothing standalone.
Domain root of a major Kosovo issuer and first Apple Pay launcher; recurring product and rollout announcements.
Active acquirer domain root; merchant/POS pages give acquiring-side terminal and acceptance detail.
Card-product sub-page with siblings on bkt-ks.com; fetch failed, so re-check liveness and monitor the bank domain instead.
Single contactless-Visa announcement page rather than a producing feed; useful as dated rollout evidence, liveness unconfirmed.
Non-bank payment institution site evidencing second-tier scheme participation and likely third-party processing in Kosovo.
Newsroom of the dominant regional ATM/POS services and processing vendor; principal window on terminal-estate engagements.
Vendor-marketing PSP country page with low credibility; redundant against issuer and BQK sourcing.
Scheme-level regional newsroom, the official channel for any Visa announcement touching Kosovo issuers or acceptance programmes.
Credible sq/sr public-service outlet producing forward-looking payments rollout reporting absent from official releases.
Static insurer product page; indirect one-off evidence on CIT/ATM replenishment economics, not a recurring signal producer.
Local CIT/private-security provider site worth mining once to map the ATM replenishment supply chain, not continuous monitoring.
Serbian-language ATM directory to mine once for northern Kosovo branch/ATM presence; low credibility for ongoing monitoring.
Trade-press stream that republishes vendor win announcements with country tagging; standard first-publication venue for Western Balkans core-banking deals.
Vendor newsroom with a named Kosovo core/lending win; keep as a standing source but fetch failed, so re-verify reachability.
ProCredit group IT arm publishing named Kosovo deliveries and annual product/country rollouts; direct installed-base disclosure.
One-off vendor case study naming the Kosovo institution, product and year; strong evidence artefact, not a recurring feed.
Vendor social channel with date-stamped named Kosovo ATM programmes, but Facebook access is login-gated and ToS-constrained; human must clear access.
Canonical long-form case-study and news library of a regional ATM/self-service integrator; fetch failed, so re-check liveness before approval.
Company-contacts page confirming the Prishtina legal entity; mine once for the local entity and pivot to the case-study library for monitoring.
System-integrator site whose financial reference list names multiple Kosovo institutions; historic installed-base map and snowball source.
Structured, country-grouped bank customer list that is worth archiving now and diffing for a future Kosovo entry.
Vendor site self-declaring a Kosovo acquiring/e-commerce footprint; about and news pages disclose bank and PSP partnerships.
Paid technographics aggregator with per-bank Kosovo profiles; valuable cross-check but paywalled and sourcing unverified.
App-store package metadata to enumerate once across Kosovo bank apps for a vendor fingerprint map of the digital-banking layer.
